BREAKING: NASA has launched a new website for its Moon Base missions 🌕🚀

The plan outlines a long-term vision to build a permanent lunar outpost near the Moon’s South Pole, with an estimated $20 billion development roadmap.

NASA describes the Moon Base as a “home away from Earth” for Artemis astronauts — a place where humans will live and work as part of the first sustained presence on another world.

The program brings together international space agencies, industry partners and academia to build and operate the lunar outpost.

@SpaceX’s Starship will play a key role in enabling these missions, providing heavy-lift capability for large-scale lunar infrastructure.

“This is the first step toward an enduring human presence beyond Earth.”
